name: Feature Request Tracker
tagline: Turns Slack threads and calls into a request list with a real customer trail
description: Mines Slack conversations and recorded calls into a living list of feature requests, and every line on it keeps a link to the customer who made the ask. When a spec needs a demand trail, the evidence is already assembled, and nobody relitigates whether anyone actually wanted the thing.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
